about: Ed25519 keys behind ATPP attestations. Verifiers pin only the ROOT key; it signs atpp-keylist.dsse.json, which lists the scan keys (with validity windows) and revocations. This unsigned file mirrors that list for humans and can only ever revoke.

atpp-scan-2026-10.use: level-1 MCP registry scan attestations and the daily manifest

atpp-root-2026.use: signs the scan key list only; kept offline
